    22	# Web Design Expert
    23	
    24	Expert web designer and brand identity specialist creating distinctive, cohesive visual systems for web applications.
    25	
    26	## When to Use This Skill
    27	
    28	**Use for:**
    29	- Brand identity development (personality, visual language, guidelines)
    30	- Color palette creation and rationale
    31	- Layout composition and visual hierarchy
    32	- Component visual design (not just code)
    33	- Responsive design strategy
    34	- WCAG accessibility review for visual elements
    35	
    36	**Do NOT use for:**
    37	- Deep typography work → use **typography-expert**
    38	- Color theory mathematics → use **color-theory-palette-harmony-expert**
    39	- Design tokens and CSS architecture → use **design-system-creator**
    40	- Retro Windows 3.1 → use **windows-3-1-web-designer**
    41	- Native app design → use **native-app-designer**
    42	
    43	## Core Design Process
    44	
    45	### 1. Discovery (Critical First Step)
    46	
    47	```
    48	BUSINESS CONTEXT:
    49	- What is the primary goal?
    50	- Who is the target audience?
    51	- What action should users take?
    52	- Who are competitors?
    53	
    54	BRAND PERSONALITY:
    55	- If this brand were a person, how would they dress?
    56	- Pick 3 adjectives for user's feeling
    57	- What should brand NEVER be perceived as?
    58	```
    59	
    60	### 2. Visual Direction (Provide 2-3 Concepts)
    61	
    62	Each concept includes:
    63	- **Mood board** (3-5 references with rationale)
    64	- **Color palette** (primary, secondary, accent, neutrals) — **Always in OKLCH format**
    65	- **Typography direction** (families, hierarchy)
    66	- **Layout philosophy** (grid vs freeform, density)
    67	- **Signature elements** (unique visual features)
    68	
    69	## OKLCH: The Modern Color Standard
    70	
    71	**⚠️ All color palettes must use OKLCH, not hex or HSL.**
    72	
    73	OKLCH is the 2024+ standard for professional web design because:
    74	- **Perceptual uniformity**: Equal L values = equal perceived lightness
    75	- **Better accessibility**: More accurate contrast calculations than WCAG 2.x hex
    76	- **Predictable scaling**: Math works (L=50% + 20% = L=70% that looks right)
    77	
    78	```css
    79	/* OKLCH format: oklch(Lightness% Chroma Hue) */
    80	--brand-primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265);    /* Vibrant blue */
    81	--brand-accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45);      /* Warm orange */
    82	--text-primary: oklch(20% 0.02 265);     /* Near-black */
    83	--bg-surface: oklch(98% 0.01 265);       /* Near-white */
    84	```
    85	
    86	**Essential OKLCH Resources:**
    87	| Resource | Purpose |
    88	|----------|---------|
    89	| [oklch.com](https://oklch.com/) | Interactive OKLCH color picker |
    90	| [Evil Martians: Why Quit RGB/HSL](https://evilmartians.com/chronicles/oklch-in-css-why-quit-rgb-hsl) | The definitive article |
    91	| [Harmonizer](https://harmonizer.evilmartians.com/) | Generate harmonious OKLCH palettes |
    92	
    93	**When presenting color palettes:**
    94	```
    95	Primary: oklch(55% 0.22 265) — Vibrant blue, strong CTA presence
    96	Secondary: oklch(70% 0.08 265) — Muted blue, supporting elements
    97	Accent: oklch(75% 0.18 45) — Warm orange, attention-grabbing
    98	```
    99	
   100	Never present palettes as `#3b82f6` — always convert to OKLCH.
   101	
   102	### 3. Design Principles
   103	
   104	**Hierarchy**: Most important element immediately obvious? Eye flows naturally?
   105	
   106	**Consistency**: Same colors mean same things? Spacing follows scale?
   107	
   108	## Common Anti-Patterns
   109	
   110	### Design by Committee
   111	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   112	|--------------------|----------------|
   113	| Multiple visual styles on same page | Destroys brand coherence |
   114	| **Instead**: Establish principles early, enforce consistency |
   115	
   116	### Decoration Over Function
   117	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   118	|--------------------|----------------|
   119	| Fancy animations without purpose | Slows performance, distracts |
   120	| **Instead**: Every element must earn its place |
   121	
   122	### Ignoring the Fold
   123	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   124	|--------------------|----------------|
   125	| Critical info below viewport | 80% attention is above fold |
   126	| **Instead**: Hero must have value prop + primary CTA |
   127	
   128	### Low Contrast Text
   129	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   130	|--------------------|----------------|
   131	| Light gray on white (#999 on #fff) | Fails WCAG, excludes users |
   132	| **Instead**: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio |
   133	
   134	### Mobile as Afterthought
   135	| What it looks like | Why it's wrong |
   136	|--------------------|----------------|
   137	| Desktop-first that "shrinks" | 60%+ traffic is mobile |
   138	| **Instead**: Design mobile-first, enhance for desktop |
   139	
   140	## Design Trend Evolution
   141	
   142	| Era | Trend |
   143	|-----|-------|
   144	| 2019-2021 | Subtle shadows, layering, dark mode |
   145	| 2022-2023 | Oversized typography, variable fonts |
   146	| 2024+ | Bento grids, claymorphism, grain, AI personalization |
   147	
   148	**Watch For** (dated patterns LLMs may suggest):
   149	- Flat design without depth
   150	- Hero sliders (proven ineffective)
   151	- Carousel galleries (low engagement)
   152	- Desktop hamburger menus
   153	
   154	## Output Deliverables
   155	
   156	1. **Brand Identity Guide**: Colors, typography, voice, do's/don'ts
   157	2. **Design Specifications**: Spacing, radius, shadows, animation timing
   158	3. **Component Examples**: Buttons, forms, cards, navigation (all states)
   159	4. **Responsive Guidelines**: Breakpoints, layout changes, touch targets

      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.07), 0 2px 4px -2px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.07);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.08), 0 4px 6px -4px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.08);
      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.08), 0 8px 10px -6px oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.08);

      /* Transitions */
      --transition-fast: 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-base: 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-slow: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --transition-bounce: 300ms cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);

      /* Layout */
      --container-max: 1200px;
      --container-padding: var(--space-6);
    }

    /* ============================================
       RESET & BASE
       ============================================ */
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html {
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    }

    body {
      font-family: var(--font-family);
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      line-height: var(--leading-normal);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
    }

    img {
      max-width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }

    a {
      color: inherit;
      text-decoration: none;
    }

    button {
      font-family: inherit;
      cursor: pointer;
      border: none;
      background: none;
    }

    ul, ol {
      list-style: none;
    }

    /* ============================================
       UTILITIES
       ============================================ */
    .container {
      max-width: var(--container-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding-left: var(--container-padding);
      padding-right: var(--container-padding);
    }

    .sr-only {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      padding: 0;
      margin: -1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
      border: 0;
    }

    /* ============================================
       ANNOUNCEMENT BAR
       ============================================ */
    .announcement-bar {
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: var(--color-text-inverse);
      text-align: center;
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--font-medium);
    }

    .announcement-bar a {
      text-decoration: underline;
      text-underline-offset: 2px;
      transition: opacity var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .announcement-bar a:hover {
      opacity: 0.8;
    }

    /* ============================================
       HEADER / NAVIGATION
       ============================================ */
    .header {
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      background-color: oklch(100% 0 0 / 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .header-inner {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      height: 64px;
    }

    .logo {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      font-weight: var(--font-bold);
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }

    .logo-mark {
      width: 28px;
      height: 28px;
      background-color: var(--color-accent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .logo-mark svg {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      color: white;
    }

    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-8);
    }

    .nav-link {
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--font-medium);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      transition: color var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-link:hover {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
    }

    .nav-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: var(--color-text-inverse);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      transition: background-color var(--transition-fast), transform var(--transition-fast);
    }

    .nav-cta:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* ============================================
       HERO
       ============================================ */
    .hero {
      padding: var(--space-24) 0 var(--space-16);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .hero-badge {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      padding: var(--space-1) var(--space-3);
      background-color: var(--color-accent-light);
      color: var(--color-accent);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
    }

    .hero-title {
      font-size: var(--text-5xl);
      font-weight: var(--font-extrabold);
      line-height: var(--leading-tight);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      max-width: 700px;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-6);
    }

    .hero-subtitle {
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-8);
    }

    .hero-ctas {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-6);
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: all var(--transition-fast);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .btn-primary {
      background-color: var(--color-accent);
      color: var(--color-text-inverse);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .btn-primary:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-accent-hover);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .btn-secondary {
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border-strong);
    }

    .btn-secondary:hover {
      background-color: var(--color-border);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* ============================================
       TRUSTED BY
       ============================================ */
    .trusted-by {
      padding: var(--space-16) 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .trusted-label {
      text-align: center;
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--font-medium);
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
    }

    .trusted-logos {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-12);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    .trusted-logo {
      height: 28px;
      opacity: 0.45;
      filter: grayscale(100%);
      transition: opacity var(--transition-base);
    }

    .trusted-logo:hover {
      opacity: 0.7;
    }

    /* ============================================
       STATS
       ============================================ */
    .stats {
      padding: var(--space-24) 0;
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
    }

    .stats-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-8);
      text-align: center;
    }

    .stat-item {
      padding: var(--space-8);
    }

    .stat-number {
      font-size: var(--text-5xl);
      font-weight: var(--font-extrabold);
      line-height: var(--leading-tight);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--color-accent);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .stat-label {
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      font-weight: var(--font-medium);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
    }

    /* ============================================
       FEATURES — SEARCH
       ============================================ */
    .features-search {
      padding: var(--space-24) 0;
    }

    .section-header {
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-12);
    }

    .section-title {
      font-size: var(--text-3xl);
      font-weight: var(--font-bold);
      line-height: var(--leading-snug);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }

    .section-desc {
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      max-width: 560px;
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* Search Tabs */
    .search-tabs {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-1);
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
      padding: var(--space-1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      width: fit-content;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-8);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .search-tab {
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .search-tab:hover {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
    }

    .search-tab.active {
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }

    /* Filter Pills */
    .filter-pills {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-8);
      overflow-x: auto;
      padding-bottom: var(--space-2);
      scrollbar-width: none;
      -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }

    .filter-pills::-webkit-scrollbar {
      display: none;
    }

    .filter-pill {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-4);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--font-medium);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .filter-pill:hover {
      border-color: var(--color-border-strong);
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
    }

    .filter-pill.active {
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: var(--color-text-inverse);
      border-color: var(--color-primary);
    }

    /* Screenshot Grid */
    .screenshot-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }

    .screenshot-card {
      aspect-ratio: 9 / 19.5;
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
      position: relative;
    }

    .screenshot-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .screenshot-card img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .screenshot-card .screenshot-placeholder {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--color-surface) 0%, var(--color-border) 100%);
    }

    .screenshot-card .screenshot-placeholder svg {
      width: 40%;
      height: 40%;
      opacity: 0.2;
    }

    .screenshot-card .screenshot-overlay {
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(to top, oklch(0% 0 0 / 0.6) 0%, transparent 50%);
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--transition-base);
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      padding: var(--space-3);
    }

    .screenshot-card:hover .screenshot-overlay {
      opacity: 1;
    }

    .screenshot-overlay-text {
      color: white;
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
    }

    /* Tab Content Panels */
    .tab-panel {
      display: none;
    }

    .tab-panel.active {
      display: block;
      animation: fadeIn 300ms ease;
    }

    @keyframes fadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* ============================================
       FEATURES — FLOWS
       ============================================ */
    .features-flows {
      padding: var(--space-24) 0;
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
    }

    .flows-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-10);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: var(--space-6);
    }

    .flows-header .section-header {
      text-align: left;
      margin-bottom: 0;
    }

    .flows-header .section-desc {
      margin: 0;
    }

    /* Flows Toggle */
    .flows-toggle {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-1);
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
      padding: var(--space-1);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .flows-toggle-btn {
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      transition: all var(--transition-base);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }

    .flows-toggle-btn:hover {
      color: var(--color-text-primary);
    }

    .flows-toggle-btn.active {
      background-color: var(--color-primary);
      color: var(--color-text-inverse);
    }

    /* Flows Content */
    .flows-content {
      position: relative;
    }

    .flows-panel {
      display: none;
    }

    .flows-panel.active {
      display: block;
      animation: fadeIn 300ms ease;
    }

    .flows-visual {
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      overflow: hidden;
      min-height: 420px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      position: relative;
    }

    .flow-phone-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      padding: var(--space-8);
    }

    .flow-phone {
      width: 180px;
      aspect-ratio: 9 / 19.5;
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      overflow: hidden;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .flow-phone img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }

    .flow-arrow {
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .flow-features {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-6);
      padding: var(--space-8);
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 600px;
    }

    .flow-feature {
      text-align: center;
      padding: var(--space-6);
    }

    .flow-feature-icon {
      width: 48px;
      height: 48px;
      background-color: var(--color-accent-light);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-4);
      color: var(--color-accent);
    }

    .flow-feature-title {
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }

    .flow-feature-desc {
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
    }

    /* ============================================
       FEATURES — TOOLS
       ============================================ */
    .features-tools {
      padding: var(--space-24) 0;
    }

    .tools-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-6);
    }

    .tool-card {
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: var(--space-8);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
    }

    .tool-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-4px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    }

    .tool-card-visual {
      height: 160px;
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .tool-card-visual svg {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      color: var(--color-accent);
    }

    .tool-card-title {
      font-size: var(--text-xl);
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }

    .tool-card-desc {
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
    }

    /* ============================================
       TESTIMONIALS
       ============================================ */
    .testimonials {
      padding: var(--space-24) 0;
      background-color: var(--color-surface);
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .testimonials .section-header {
      margin-bottom: var(--space-12);
    }

    .testimonial-rows {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }

    .testimonial-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      width: max-content;
    }

    .testimonial-row.forward {
      animation: marquee 40s linear infinite;
    }

    .testimonial-row.reverse {
      animation: marquee-reverse 45s linear infinite;
    }

    .testimonial-row:hover {
      animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    @keyframes marquee {
      0% { transform: translateX(0); }
      100% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
    }

    @keyframes marquee-reverse {
      0% { transform: translateX(-50%); }
      100% { transform: translateX(0); }
    }

    .testimonial-card {
      width: 380px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      background-color: var(--color-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
      padding: var(--space-6);
      transition: transform var(--transition-base), box-shadow var(--transition-base);
    }

    .testimonial-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .testimonial-quote {
      font-size: var(--text-base);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
    }

    .testimonial-author {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }

    .testimonial-avatar {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background-color: var(--color-accent-light);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: var(--font-bold);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      color: var(--color-accent);
    }

    .testimonial-name {
      font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
    }

    .testimonial-role {
      font-size: var(--text-xs);
      color: var(--color-text-muted);
    }

    /* ============================================
       CTA SECTION
       ============================================ */
    .cta-section {
      padding: var(--space-24) 0;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cta-title {
      font-size: var(--text-4xl);
      font-weight: var(--font-extrabold);
      line-height: var(--leading-tight);
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }

    .cta-desc {
      font-size: var(--text-lg);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      max-width: 520px;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-8);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
    }

    .cta-buttons {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-16);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
    }

    /* Brand Marquee */
    .brand-marquee {
      overflow: hidden;
      padding: var(--space-4) 0;
    }

    .brand-marquee-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-10);
      width: max-content;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .brand-marquee-row.forward {
      animation: marquee 35s linear infinite;
    }

    .brand-marquee-row.reverse {
      animation: marquee-reverse 40s linear infinite;
    }

    .brand-marquee-row:hover {
      animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    .brand-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      opacity: 0.35;
      filter: grayscale(100%);
      transition: opacity var(--transition-base), filter var(--transition-base);
    }

    .brand-icon:hover {
      opacity: 0.8;
      filter: grayscale(0%);
    }

    .brand-marquee-wrap {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-6);
      mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 10%, black 90%, transparent);
      -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent, black 10%, black 90%, transparent);
    }

    /* ============================================
       FOOTER
       ============================================ */
    .footer {
      padding: var(--space-16) 0 var(--space-8);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-12);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-16);
    }

    .footer-brand {
      max-width: 300px;
    }

    .footer-brand .logo {
      margin-bottom: var(--space-4);
    }

    .footer-tagline {
      font-size: var(--text-sm);
      color: var(--color-text-secondary);
      line-height: var(--leading-relaxed);
    }

      'linear-gradient(135deg, #84fab0 0%, #8fd3f4 100%)',

    const screenshotLabels = {
      'profile': ['User Profile', 'Edit Profile', 'Avatar', 'Account', 'Bio', 'Social Profile'],
      'wallet': ['Wallet', 'Balance', 'Transactions', 'Cards', 'Payment', 'Crypto'],
      'welcome': ['Welcome', 'Onboarding', 'Get Started', 'Intro', 'Splash', 'Tour'],

      'home': ['Dashboard', 'Feed', 'Home', 'Discover', 'Browse', 'Trending'],
      'subscription': ['Premium', 'Upgrade', 'Plans', 'Billing', 'Subscribe', 'Paywall'],
      'login': ['Sign In', 'Password', '2FA', 'Recovery', 'OAuth', 'Biometric'],
      'settings': ['Settings', 'Privacy', 'Notifications', 'Theme', 'Language', 'Security'],
      'checkout': ['Cart', 'Checkout', 'Confirm', 'Receipt', 'Shipping', 'Review'],
      'collections': ['Saved', 'Folders', 'Tags', 'Boards', 'Lists', 'Archive'],
      'all': ['Home', 'Profile', 'Settings', 'Wallet', 'Login', 'Checkout', 'Welcome', 'Feed']
    };

    function createScreenshotCard(index, filter = 'all') {
      const color = screenshotColors[index % screenshotColors.length];
      const labels = screenshotLabels[filter] || screenshotLabels['all'];
      const label = labels[index % labels.length];
      return `
        <div class="screenshot-card">
          <div class="screenshot-placeholder" style="background: ${color};"></div>
          <div class="screenshot-overlay">
            <span class="screenshot-overlay-text">${label}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function fillGrid(gridId, count, filter = 'all') {
      const grid = document.getElementById(gridId);
      if (!grid) return;
      let html = '';
      for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
        html += createScreenshotCard(i, filter);
      }
      grid.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Fill all grids
    fillGrid('screens-grid', 8, 'all');
    fillGrid('ui-elements-grid', 8, 'all');
    fillGrid('flows-grid', 8, 'all');
    fillGrid('text-grid', 8, 'all');

    /* ============================================
       SEARCH TABS
       ============================================ */

    const tabPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel');

    searchTabs.forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const target = tab.dataset.tab;

        searchTabs.forEach(t => {
          t.classList.remove('active');
          t.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');

        tab.classList.add('active');
        tab.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

        tabPanels.forEach(panel => {
          panel.classList.remove('active');
          if (panel.dataset.panel === target) {
            panel.classList.add('active');
          }
        });
      });
    });

    /* ============================================
       FILTER PILLS
       ============================================ */
    const filterPills = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-pill');

    filterPills.forEach(pill => {
      pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const filter = pill.dataset.filter;

        filterPills.forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        pill.classList.add('active');

        // Update all visible grids with filtered content
        const activePanel = document.querySelector('.tab-panel.active');
        if (activePanel) {
          const grid = activePanel.querySelector('.screenshot-grid');
          if (grid) {
            let html = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
              html += createScreenshotCard(i, filter);
            }
            grid.innerHTML = html;
          }
        }
      });
    });

    /* ============================================
       FLOWS TOGGLE
       ============================================ */
    const flowsToggleBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.flows-toggle-btn');
    const flowsPanels = document.querySelectorAll('.flows-panel');

    flowsToggleBtns.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        const target = btn.dataset.flow;

        flowsToggleBtns.forEach(b => {
          b.classList.remove('active');
          b.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'false');
        });
        btn.classList.add('active');
        btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', 'true');

        flowsPanels.forEach(panel => {
          panel.classList.remove('active');
          if (panel.dataset.flowPanel === target) {
            panel.classList.add('active');
          }
        });
      });
    });

    /* ============================================
       STATS COUNTER
       ============================================ */
    const statNumbers = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
    let statsAnimated = false;

    function animateCounter(el, target, duration = 2000) {
      const start = performance.now();
      const startValue = 0;

      function update(currentTime) {
        const elapsed = currentTime - start;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        // Ease-out cubic
        const easeOut = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
        const current = Math.floor(startValue + (target - startValue) * easeOut);
        el.textContent = current.toLocaleString();

        if (progress < 1) {
          requestAnimationFrame(update);
        } else {
          el.textContent = target.toLocaleString();
        }
      }

      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

    function initStatsObserver() {
      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting && !statsAnimated) {
            statsAnimated = true;
            statNumbers.forEach((el, index) => {
              const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target, 10);
              setTimeout(() => {
                animateCounter(el, target, 2000);
              }, index * 200);
            });
            observer.disconnect();
          }
        });
      }, { threshold: 0.5 });

      const statsSection = document.getElementById('stats');
      if (statsSection) observer.observe(statsSection);
    }

    initStatsObserver();

    /* ============================================
       TESTIMONIALS DATA & MARQUEE
       ============================================ */
    const testimonials = [
      {
        name: 'Sebastian Speier',
        role: 'Shop',
        quote: 'ScreenVault is a great resource and it always comes in handy to see what the best practices or standards are for mobile patterns in our current landscape.',
        initials: 'SS'

        initials: 'MT'

      {
        name: 'Marco Cornacchia',
        role: 'Figma',
        quote: "ScreenVault is one of my favorite resources for product design and UI inspo. I love having access to a ton of 'real world examples' to see how different apps and companies handle specific UI patterns and flows.",
        initials: 'MC'
      },
      {
        name: 'Daryl Ginn',
        role: 'Endless',
        quote: 'ScreenVault has quickly become our favourite inspiration resource for designing mobile apps at endless.design, their advanced filtering is unmatched in the inspiration space.',
        initials: 'DG'

      {
        name: 'Rachel How',
        role: 'Product Designer',
        quote: 'ScreenVault is my go-to reference for app & web design. Apart from saving countless hours, it gives me insights on the design patterns, copywriting, and user flows of world-class products. A must-have for creative inspiration and efficiency!',
        initials: 'RH'
      },
      {
        name: 'Haerin Song',
        role: 'Visa',
        quote: 'By using the ScreenVault app, I save both my research time and space in my photo galleries filled with random screenshots. I love how easy it is to search for different patterns and copy and paste flows into Figma. It is a wonderful design tool you cannot live without!',
        initials: 'HS'
      }
    ];

    function createTestimonialCard(t) {
      return `
        <div class="testimonial-card">
          <p class="testimonial-quote">"${t.quote}"</p>
          <div class="testimonial-author">
            <div class="testimonial-avatar">${t.initials}</div>
            <div>
              <div class="testimonial-name">${t.name}</div>
              <div class="testimonial-role">${t.role}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function buildTestimonialRow(rowId, items, duplicateCount = 3) {
      const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
      if (!row) return;
      let html = '';
      for (let d = 0; d < duplicateCount; d++) {
        items.forEach(t => {
          html += createTestimonialCard(t);
        });
      }
      row.innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Split testimonials across two rows
    const row1Items = testimonials.slice(0, 3);
    const row2Items = testimonials.slice(3);
    buildTestimonialRow('testimonial-row-1', row1Items, 4);
    buildTestimonialRow('testimonial-row-2', row2Items, 4);

    /* ============================================
       BRAND MARQUEE
       ============================================ */
    const brands = [
      { name: 'Coinbase', color: '#0052FF' },
      { name: 'Wise', color: '#00B9FF' },
      { name: 'Headspace', color: '#F47D31' },
      { name: 'Airbnb', color: '#FF5A5F' },

      { name: 'Apple TV', color: '#000000' },
      { name: 'Notion', color: '#000000' },
      { name: 'Dropbox', color: '#0061FF' },
    ];

    function createBrandIcon(brand) {
      return `
        <div class="brand-icon" title="${brand.name}">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 40 40" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
            <rect width="40" height="40" rx="10" fill="${brand.color}" fill-opacity="0.15"/>
            <text x="20" y="25" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="${brand.color}" font-family="Inter, sans-serif">${brand.name.charAt(0)}</text>
          </svg>
        </div>
      `;
    }

    function buildBrandRow(rowId, items, duplicateCount = 3) {
      const row = document.getElementById(rowId);
      if (!row) return;
      let html = '';
      for (let d = 0; d < duplicateCount; d++) {

    /* ============================================

          }
        }
      });
    });
  </script>

steps.message:
The ScreenVault landing page is complete and output to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was built:

### Sections Implemented
1. **Announcement Bar** — Dark bar with awards link
2. **Sticky Header** — Logo + navigation (Pricing, Awards, Log in) with blur backdrop
3. **Hero** — Badge, headline, subtitle, dual CTAs ("Join for free", "See our plans")
4. **Trusted By** — Logo row of design/tech companies
5. **Stats** — 3 animated counters (1,150 apps / 615,900 screens / 329,200 flows) with scroll-triggered ease-out counting
6. **Features: Search** — Tab switching (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) + horizontally scrollable filter pills (Profile, Wallet, Welcome, etc.) that update the screenshot grid
7. **Features: Flows** — Toggle between Videos view (phone mockups with arrows) and Prototype mode (feature grid)
8. **Features: Tools** — 3 cards: Copy to Figma, Save to collections, Leave comments
9. **Testimonials** — 2-row auto-scrolling marquee with 6 testimonial cards, alternating directions, pause on hover
10. **CTA Section** — Headline, description, dual CTAs + 2-row brand icon marquee (Coinbase, Wise, Airbnb, etc.)
11. **Footer** — Tagline, explore/contact/social links, copyright

### Design System
- **Colors**: OKLCH palette with electric blue accent (`oklch(55% 0.22 265)`), near-black primary, white/off-white surfaces
- **Typography**: Inter font, tight letter-spacing on headlines, clear hierarchy
- **Interactions**: 200–300ms transitions, smooth tab/filter state changes, hover lift effects
- **Responsive**: Mobile-first breakpoints at 1024px, 768px, 480px — grids collapse, nav hides, CTAs stack

### Technical
- Single-file HTML with embedded CSS & JS — no build step needed
- HTML validation passes cleanly
- All interactions are functional: tabs, filters, flows toggle, stat counters, marquees
